description: Public-safe metric source and trust metadata for PBJ320 free site. Enriched copies from pbjapp may override at runtime.

metrics.plain_english_source: Recorded by state survey agencies during on-site health inspections and published in CMS Provider Information.
metrics.public_caveat: Deficiency counts reflect survey findings at a point in time; they do not describe every aspect of care.

metrics.plain_english_source: Documented in CMS Provider Information from complaint-related survey activity.
metrics.public_caveat: Complaint surveys may not capture all resident or family concerns.

metrics.plain_english_source: Federal enforcement actions published in CMS Provider Information and related CMS datasets.
metrics.public_caveat: Penalty totals may not include all state-level actions or private settlements.

metrics.plain_english_source: CMS Care Compare abuse flag when a facility has a substantiated abuse citation in the look-back window described in the Five-Star Technical Users' Guide.
metrics.public_caveat: PBJ320 displays CMS's flag when present; confirm on Care Compare before citing in formal work.

metrics.plain_english_source: CMS Special Focus Facility program listings and related CMS publications.
metrics.public_caveat: SFF candidacy and graduation reflect CMS program rules at the time of posting.

metrics.plain_english_source: CMS Payroll-Based Journal daily nurse staffing public use files, submitted by facilities from payroll records.
metrics.public_caveat: PBJ reports paid hours, not shift-level care delivery or bedside presence.

metrics.plain_english_source: Total reported nursing hours divided by average daily census from CMS PBJ quarterly or daily files.
metrics.public_caveat: HPRD can rise when census falls even if total hours are unchanged.

metrics.plain_english_source: Reported RN hours (including RN admin and DON where included) divided by census from CMS PBJ.
metrics.public_caveat: Job-code mix and contract staff are facility-reported in PBJ.

metrics.plain_english_source: Reported LPN and LPN administrator hours divided by census from CMS PBJ.
metrics.public_caveat: LPN totals depend on how facilities classify roles in PBJ submissions.

metrics.plain_english_source: Reported CNA, nurse aide in training, and medication aide hours divided by census from CMS PBJ.
metrics.public_caveat: Aide hours reflect payroll records, not observed direct-care time per resident.

metrics.plain_english_source: Derived from CMS PBJ daily files by aggregating Saturday and Sunday reported hours.
metrics.public_caveat: Weekend patterns vary by facility scheduling; a single weekend may not represent typical coverage.

metrics.plain_english_source: Contract or agency hours as a share of total reported hours in CMS PBJ.
metrics.public_caveat: Contract share describes workforce mix, not care quality or compliance.

metrics.plain_english_source: Calculated by CMS from Minimum Data Set (MDS) assessments submitted by facilities.
metrics.public_caveat: Quality measures depend on assessment timing and coding; they are not independent observations.

metrics.plain_english_source: CMS quality measures for long-stay residents from MDS assessments in Provider Information.
metrics.public_caveat: Long-stay measures may lag changes in staffing or operations.

metrics.plain_english_source: CMS quality measures for short-stay residents from MDS assessments in Provider Information.
metrics.public_caveat: Short-stay populations and discharge patterns can affect these rates.

metrics.plain_english_source: CMS nursing case-mix index and expected staffing hours from Provider Information, based on MDS-derived acuity.
metrics.public_caveat: Case-mix is an acuity benchmark for comparison, not a legal staffing minimum.

metrics.plain_english_source: CMS Five-Star composite and component ratings from Provider Information.
metrics.public_caveat: Star ratings combine multiple inputs, including self-reported and survey-based components.

metrics.plain_english_source: PBJ320 ranks a facility's reported total nurse HPRD against other facilities in the same state for the quarter shown.
metrics.public_caveat: Percentiles are not case-mix adjusted and do not establish legal or clinical conclusions.

metrics.plain_english_source: PBJ320 ordering of states or facilities by reported PBJ metrics for a selected quarter.
metrics.public_caveat: Rankings describe relative reported staffing, not overall quality or compliance.

metrics.plain_english_source: Mapped direct-care nursing hours (RN, LPN, CNA, nurse aide trainee, medication aide) divided by census from CMS PBJ daily files.
metrics.public_caveat: Role mapping follows configured state rules (e.g. NY § 2895-b); excludes DON and nursing administrator hours where applicable.

metrics.plain_english_source: PBJ320 counts PBJ daily facility-days where the configured staffing metric for that state falls below the paired threshold (e.g. NY direct-care HPRD vs. 3.50; CT total nursing HPRD vs. 3.06).
metrics.public_caveat: Threshold labels describe reference lines for screening; PBJ320 does not make legal findings of violation.

metrics.plain_english_source: PBJ320 comparison of weekend reported HPRD to weekday or state peer context where shown.
metrics.public_caveat: Weekend gaps are descriptive patterns that may warrant closer review, not proof of understaffing.

metrics.plain_english_source: PBJ320 compares reported facility or state metrics to state or national aggregates from the same PBJ files.
metrics.public_caveat: State averages mask wide within-state variation among facilities.

metrics.plain_english_source: PBJ320 aggregates CMS ownership, chain performance, and related public records where available.
metrics.public_caveat: Ownership links may be incomplete; CMS owner data does not cover every control structure.

metrics.plain_english_source: PBJ320 counts PBJ daily records where total reported RN, RN admin, and DON hours sum to zero.
metrics.public_caveat: Zero-hour days may reflect reporting quirks; verify against daily PBJ before relying on a single day.

metrics.plain_english_source: PBJ320 counts PBJ daily records where total reported RN, RN admin, and DON hours are below eight.
metrics.public_caveat: This screen uses facility-wide daily totals, not shift-level RN coverage.
